name: ema_E1
_comment: JOB E phase 2 running-average arm, written 2026-11-11 21:09 before it ran. It repeats stage S2 of phase 1 exactly (resumes a copy of _work/runs/main/stage_S1.pt at 1.0B, one cosine cycle to 2.0B, peak lr 5e-4, alpha 0.25, no decay) and keeps three exponential running averages of the weights next to the trained weights (avg += (1 - d) * (w - avg) after every step; d = 0.9999, 0.99997, 0.99999, i.e. horizons of about 82M, 273M and 819M presentations; each average starts from the 1.0B weights). The averaged nets are exported and scored at every checkpoint; they do not influence the training itself.
